post.summary: Invite someone to the team by their username
post.description: They get a notification and have 7 days to accept. Nothing works for them until their identity verification is approved, except scanning tickets at events, which anyone can do. A team holds up to 20 people, invites included. Permissions that need another (such as "See orders") bring it with them. Pay is optional and shown to them with the invite, so they can compare offers. Withdrawals, payment details, publishing, deleting and the team itself stay with the owner.

post.summary: Upload a file to print
post.description: Send the file's bytes as the body with its Content-Type (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 25 MB) and its name in X-File-Name. PDF pages are counted for pricing. Files only the shop you order from can open; ones not ordered within a day are deleted.

post.summary: What an order would cost, and the coupons that work on it
post.description: The same checks and prices as placing it, so a quote that passes can be ordered. With `couponCode` the price has it taken off, or `couponProblem` says why it can't be used.

post.summary: Upload a file to attach to an order or a delivery
post.description: Send the file itself with Content-Type application/octet-stream and its name in `name`. Up to Ruxstar's delivery size (at most 25 MB); the files on one order or one delivery add up to that too. Allowed: the kinds in GET /v1/gigs/rules `limits.extensions`, out of pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, heic, psd, ai, eps, mp4, mov, webm, mp3, wav, m4a, zip, txt, csv, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, ttf, otf. Then pass its id in `fileIds`. Files not used within a day are deleted; used ones go a set number of days after the order ends.
